title: New Year and Hurry
statementMd:
Limak is going to participate in a contest on the last day of the 2016. The contest will start at 20:00 and will last four hours, exactly until midnight. There will be $*n*$ problems, sorted by difficulty, i.e. problem $1$ is the easiest and problem $*n*$ is the hardest. Limak knows it will take him $5·*i*$ minutes to solve the $*i*$-th problem.

Limak's friends organize a New Year's Eve party and Limak wants to be there at midnight or earlier. He needs $*k*$ minutes to get there from his house, where he will participate in the contest first.

How many problems can Limak solve if he wants to make it to the party?

## Input

The only line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 240$) — the number of the problems in the contest and the number of minutes Limak needs to get to the party from his house.

## Output

Print one integer, denoting the maximum possible number of problems Limak can solve so that he could get to the party at midnight or earlier.

## Note

In the first sample, there are $3$ problems and Limak needs $222$ minutes to get to the party. The three problems require $5$, $10$ and $15$ minutes respectively. Limak can spend $5 + 10 = 15$ minutes to solve first two problems. Then, at 20:15 he can leave his house to get to the party at 23:57 (after $222$ minutes). In this scenario Limak would solve $2$ problems. He doesn't have enough time to solve $3$ problems so the answer is $2$.

In the second sample, Limak can solve all $4$ problems in $5 + 10 + 15 + 20 = 50$ minutes. At 20:50 he will leave the house and go to the party. He will get there exactly at midnight.

In the third sample, Limak needs only $1$ minute to get to the party. He has enough time to solve all $7$ problems.
statementZhMd:
Limak 将参加 2016 年的最后一天举行的一场竞赛。竞赛将在 20:00 开始，持续四个小时，恰好在午夜结束。竞赛中有 $*n*$ 道题目，题目按难度排序，即第 1 题最简单，第 $*n*$ 题最难。Limak 知道，他需要 $5·*i*$ 分钟才能解决第 $*i*$ 道题。

Limak 的朋友们正在组织新年前夜聚会，Limak 希望在午夜或更早到达聚会地点。他从家到聚会地点需要 $*k*$ 分钟，而他会先在家参加竞赛。

如果 Limak 希望及时到达聚会地点，他最多能解决多少道题？

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10$, $1 ≤ *k* ≤ 240$）——竞赛中的题目数量，以及 Limak 从家到聚会地点所需的分钟数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 Limak 为了在午夜或更早到达聚会地点，最多可以解决的题目数量。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，共有 $3$ 道题，Limak 需要 $222$ 分钟才能到达聚会地点。三道题分别需要 $5$、$10$ 和 $15$ 分钟。Limak 可以花费 $5 + 10 = 15$ 分钟解决前两道题。然后，他可以在 20:15 离开家，经过 $222$ 分钟后于 23:57 到达聚会地点。在这种情况下，Limak 可以解决 $2$ 道题。他没有足够的时间解决 $3$ 道题，因此答案是 $2$。

在第二个样例中，Limak 可以用 $5 + 10 + 15 + 20 = 50$ 分钟解决全部 $4$ 道题。他将在 20:50 离开家并前往聚会地点，恰好在午夜到达。

在第三个样例中，Limak 只需要 $1$ 分钟即可到达聚会地点。他有足够的时间解决全部 $7$ 道题。
